{{Top}}
{{Quote|Tyatee, ah-ah azar, tyatee, ah-ah yahwah&hellip;|Logray reciting a magic formula in Ewokese|<ref name="Star Wars: Ewoks—Shadows of Endor">''[[Star Wars: Ewoks—Shadows of Endor]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Scroll_of_the_Mantigrue2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Scroll of the Mantigrue]] was written in Ewokese.]]
'''Ewokese''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] claimed Ewokese was a primitive language, but despite its isolation, he was able to understand it. Ewoks were able to learn and speak other languages, including [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. It was a dialect of a language from the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref>[[Ewoks (1985) 10]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The language of the Ewoks first appeared in [[1983]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the last installment of the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="RotJ" />
The Ewokese featured in ''Return of the Jedi'' was developed by [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] sound designer [[Ben Burtt]], and was largely based on Kalmyk, a [[Wikipedia:Mongolian language|Mongolian]], nomadic tribal dialect. [[Wikipedia:Languages of Africa|African]] and [[Wikipedia:Oceanic languages|South-Pacific]] languages also influenced Ewokese.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> The primary inspiration, however, was the Kalmyk Oirat language, spoken by Russians of Kalmyk ethnicity. He decided to make Ewokese based on that language after hearing it in a documentary. He got an 80-year-old Kalmyk woman to speak tales of her people through her native tongue, and then recorded the sounds, with the various actors imitating various portions of the recording (one of the actual sentences that the Kalmyk woman spoke can be translated as "what should I tell them, I don't know what to say)." In addition, Ben Burtt and [[Anthony Daniels]] later used and even invented their own terms in the language when doing the scene where C-3PO was reciting the story of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] efforts to stop the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref>{{FilmVideo|6}}</ref>

Ewokese was featured more prominently in ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''<ref name="COC">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> and ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'', a duology of made-for-TV films set on the forest moon of Endor. According to the movie credits, the Ewokese dialogues were created by [[Mari Mine-Rutka]].<ref name="BFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>

According to the ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', Ewokese had no written form.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> While [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode "[[The Haunted Village]]" shows writing that Ewoks can read, it also ([[Ewoks (television series)#Continuity|like all ''Ewoks'' episodes]]) depicts Ewoks speaking Basic rather than Ewokese, demonstrating a lack of strict fidelity to [[canon]] in matters of Ewokese.<ref name="EHV">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref>
